title: International payments partner | EC Assets
description: How to fund your Blocked Account from abroad through our international payments partner: local currencies, transparent fees, tracking and support.

blocks.text: Fund your Blocked Account from anywhere

blocks.html: Sending a large sum across borders should feel safe, simple and predictable. That is why deposits to your Blocked Account run through our international payments partner, a global payment company that specialises in exactly this.
Together we make sure your money arrives quickly and securely, so you can concentrate on the rest of your move.
Pay in your own currency
Many currencies are supported, with the exchange rate and fee shown before you confirm.
Secure and regulated
Our partner is licensed as a payment institution and used by universities and institutions in many countries.
Tracking and support
Follow your payment in real time, and reach a multilingual support team if you have a question.
Begin your payment in the EC Assets portal and send your deposit the secure, transparent way.

blocks.style: btn btn-m btn-solid btn-white text-base fill-base btn-icon btn-icon-back

blocks.html: In your EC Assets portal, open My payments under Blocked Account. You see pending payments and can start a new one with Initiate payment.
Select the country you are paying from. The transfer must come from a bank account in that country.
The full amount required for your Blocked Account, or a part of it if you prefer to pay in instalments.
Select our payments partner as the method and pick your local-currency option.
Bank transfer, credit or debit card, or one of the local payment methods available in your country.
EC Assets emails you as soon as the funds have arrived in your Blocked Account.
